editorial:
Imagine a world where the people meant to protect you are actually the ones paying for your death. That is exactly what you get in this gritty ride. You follow a secret group of assassins who take out bad guys for a living, but things get messy when a corrupt government official hires a different team of killers to hunt them down. It feels like a deadly game of cat and mouse where nobody can be trusted, and the tension builds up as the two groups clash in a series of brutal fights. The vibe is dark and moody, making you feel the danger in every shadow.

What really pops here is the action and the way the plot twists keep you guessing. The fight scenes are raw and exciting, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you enjoy old-school crime stories with high stakes, you will love this. It is a great pick for fans of classic Japanese cinema.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a massive showdown where the two groups of assassins finally meet. After a lot of blood and betrayal, the corrupt bureaucrat who started the whole fight thinks he has won. However, the main assassins get the upper hand and kill him in a satisfying way. It shows that no matter how much power you have, you cannot escape the people you try to cheat. Everything wraps up with the survivors walking away into the dark.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic assassin stories and Japanese crime dramas.
